title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-08-04 08:12:02 最新章节：第372章 没人告诉我是车轮战啊
slug: 夫人她只想修仙第370章自爆
content_zh:
“啪！”
“颜筝！
你怎么这么恶毒？就不能像你姐姐一样大度些吗？我都已经承诺要娶你了，你为什么还是如此咄咄逼人，非要揪着潇潇不放？”
一身华服，满头珠钗的女人呆愣在原地，一张绝美的脸庞上泛着红印，眉眼之间满是呆滞。
好像被眼前这个身着玄衣，满身威严气的男子吓傻了。
颜筝的确吓傻了。
我去，这是什么情况？
她环顾四周，古色古香的木桌木椅雕琢着别样的风华，除了和她家没有丝毫相像的之外，一切都很好。
见她没有说话，男子冷哼一声，满目痛心：“你害死了桐儿，我娶你，全看在你背后将军府势力的份上！
我劝你不要不识好歹，奢求你不配得到的东西！
等潇潇入府后，我会把掌家大权交给她，你既然费尽心思想尽我的齐王府，那你就老老实实的待在那里，守一辈子的寡吧！
我是绝对不会给你爱的！”
什么桐儿，什么潇潇，什么齐王府，过于熟悉的名称一股脑的钻进颜筝的脑中。
她瞪大双眼，不可置信，老娘我，不会穿书了吧？
穿进了前天晚上通宵熬夜看的无脑虐文《齐王他偏宠我》？
说是无脑虐文，完全是因为这作者写这篇文的时候压根没把女主当人看！
原女主出身高贵，是将军府的嫡次女，姑母是当今皇后，如今当朝天子也能称得上一句姑丈。
这样高的身份要什么，男人得不到？
偏偏喜欢男主，齐王——齐长卿。
这齐长卿身份也不一般，是端朝唯一一位异姓王，从身份来看，两者也算般配，只是齐长卿喜欢的不是颜筝，而是她嫡亲的姐姐，京城第一才女颜桐。

她倾国倾城，温柔和善，挥挥笔墨便能谱出一首诗篇，舞一舞衣袖，便能引来满城风云。
她漂亮，善良，富有才情，所有美好的词语好像都能在她身上体现。
与之对比，颜筝这个妹妹就显得一无是处。
除了那张漂亮的脸蛋和颜桐差不多外，简直毫无长处。
所以在颜桐莫名失踪后，所有人都在怀疑颜筝。
怀疑是她这个废物妹妹嫉妒姐姐的荣誉，暗害了她！
就连颜筝一直苦苦爱恋的齐长卿也是这么觉得。
为了给自己的白月光报仇，齐长卿玩弄颜筝的感情，在赏花宴上将颜桐送他的玉佩扔进池塘，并且命令颜筝在满城贵妇面前跳进池塘，为他捞那一枚玉佩。
如此种种折辱她的行为，齐长卿做的无比顺手。
满京城都知道，颜筝爱齐长卿如命，为了嫁给齐王，不惜抛弃脸面。
她早已成为整个端朝的笑话。
但和之后齐长卿对颜筝做的事相比，都是轻的。
齐长卿一面厌恶颜筝害了颜桐，一面又因为颜桐，对颜筝那张脸欲罢不能，在发觉自己对颜筝动心后，胆战心惊，逼迫自己喜欢上了颜家表妹颜潇潇，并且发誓要将潇潇抬为平妻。
content_en:
"Crack!"
"Yan Zheng!
Why are you so vicious? Can't you be more generous like your sister? I have already promised to marry you, why are you still so aggressive and insisting on holding on to Xiaoxiao? "
The woman dressed in gorgeous clothes and with hair full of pearls was stunned on the spot, with red marks on her beautiful face, and dull expressions between her brows and eyes.
He seemed to be frightened by the majestic man in black clothes in front of him.
Yan Zheng was indeed frightened.
Let me go, what is going on?
She looked around. The antique wooden tables and chairs were carved with a different kind of elegance. Except for the fact that they were not similar to her home at all, everything was fine.
Seeing that she didn't speak, the man snorted coldly, his eyes full of pain: "You killed Tong'er, and I only married you because of the power of the General's Mansion behind you!
I advise you not to be reckless and ask for things you don’t deserve!
After Xiaoxiao enters the palace, I will hand over the power of running the family to her. Since you have put all your efforts into my Prince Qi's palace, then you can stay there honestly and remain a widow for the rest of your life!
I will never give you love! "
What's Tong'er, what's Xiaoxiao, what's Prince Qi's Mansion, all the overly familiar names entered Yan Zheng's mind.
Her eyes widened in disbelief, I can't wear books anymore, can I?
Did you slip into the mindless sadistic novel "The King of Qi He Favors Me" that you stayed up all night to read the night before yesterday?
It is said to be a mindless piece of abuse, simply because the author did not consider the heroine as a human being when he wrote this article!
The original heroine was born into a noble family and was the legitimate second daughter of the general's palace. Her aunt was the current queen, and the current emperor could also be called uncle.
What does such a high status require that a man cannot get?
I just like the male protagonist, King Qi - Qi Changqing.
This Qi Changqing's identity is also unusual. He is the only king with a different surname in the Duan Dynasty. Judging from their identities, the two are a good match, but Qi Changqing likes not Yan Zheng, but her biological sister, Yan Tong, the most talented woman in the capital.
She is charming to the whole country, gentle and kind. She can compose a poem with a swipe of her pen and attract the attention of the whole city with a wave of her sleeves.
She is beautiful, kind, and talented, and all the beautiful words seem to be reflected in her.
In contrast, the younger sister Yan Zheng seems to be useless.
Except for his pretty face, which is similar to that of Yan Tong, he has absolutely no advantages.
So after Yan Tong disappeared inexplicably, everyone was suspicious of Yan Zheng.
I suspect that her good-for-nothing sister is jealous of her sister's honor and has assassinated her!
Even Qi Changqing, who Yan Zheng has been in love with for a long time, feels the same way.
In order to avenge his Bai Yueguang, Qi Changqing played with Yan Zheng's feelings and threw the jade pendant given to him by Yan Tong into the pond at the flower viewing party, and ordered Yan Zheng to jump into the pond in front of the ladies in the city to fish for the jade pendant for him.
Qi Changqing did all these humiliating things with ease.
Everyone in the capital knew that Yan Zheng loved Qi Changqing dearly, and would not hesitate to abandon his face in order to marry the King of Qi.
She has already become a joke to the entire Duan Dynasty.
But compared with what Qi Changqing did to Yan Zheng later, it was all light.
On the one hand, Qi Changqing hated Yan Zheng for harming Yan Tong, but on the other hand, he couldn't stop loving Yan Zheng's face because of Yan Tong. After realizing that he was attracted to Yan Zheng, he was frightened and forced himself to fall in love with Yan Xiaoxiao, a cousin of the Yan family, and vowed to make Xiaoxiao his equal wife.
